# WebPuppet

> WebPuppet is a browser face puppet studio. Webcam face tracking drives layered 2D puppets on your device. Camera and mic data never leave your browser.

## When to use WebPuppet

Use WebPuppet to animate layered 2D puppets from a webcam and microphone, try a sample performance with no camera, record a short take on the timeline, or explore behaviors such as head tracking, blink, eye gaze, nutcracker jaw, breathe, physics, walk, dragger, swap sets, and triggers.

Do not use WebPuppet as a cloud inference product. Vision and audio analysis run in the visitor browser.

## Characters

- The Jester Co-Host
- The Grumpy Crypto Bull
- Over Caffeinated Robot Intern
- The Wise Old Owl Mentor
- The Pixel Art Street Kid
- Classic Host

## Core capabilities

- Webcam face tracking via MediaPipe Face Landmarker (WebWorker, self hosted model)
- Try without a camera sample performance
- Audio lip sync on device
- Behaviors: head tracking, blink, auto blink, eye gaze, nutcracker jaw, breathe, physics, walk, dragger
- Keyboard and on screen triggers
- Timeline record and playback
- Export active puppet as a zip (puppet.json plus layer PNGs)
- Settings and last recording autosaved in IndexedDB
- Pixi.js hierarchical viewport

## Technical notes for agents

- Stack: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Pixi.js, MediaPipe Tasks Vision
- Cross origin isolation headers enable SharedArrayBuffer when available
- Tracking quality indicator: Good, Slow, Off
- No authenticated API. All media processing is on the client.
